text:
A ship sends a pulse of sound vertically downwards to the sea bed. An echo is heard
0.4 seconds later.
If the speed of sound in the water is 1200m/s, how deep is the water below the ship?
A
B
C
D
240m
480m
1500m
3000m
subject: Physics
